title: Mackerel Jjigae Bento
description: A Japanese-inspired take on the Korean classic, featuring mackerel and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy bento box.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the mackerel fillets on it.
Drizzle with a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the mackerel is baking, heat a small amount of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced zucchini and carrots and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang and soy sauce, and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the bento box, place a scoop of sushi rice on the bottom, followed by a piece of mackerel, some of the vegetable mixture, and finally a sprinkle of green onions.
